title: Blasted Heath
wikitext:
'''Blasted Heath''' is a [[neighborhood]] of [[Dunwich]]. It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

==Mythos Source==
The Blasted Heath is described in detail in the story ''The Colour Out of Space'', written by H.P. Lovecraft (1927).

==Locations==
*[[Devil's Hopyard]]
*[[Gardners' Place]]
*[[Harney Jones' Shack]]
